baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative from ج ع ل governs ب ل د plus ء م ن, while the coordinated imperative from ج ن ب governs the speaker and ب ن ي before ع ب د plus ص ن م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is asked to effect a condition in a bounded habitat: outward safety and inward trust are maintained by actively placing the family outside the devotional reach of embodied cult objects. Civic security and cultic separation are two parts of one protective arrangement.

activation_trace.role: The branch makes the addressee an agent of nurture, repair, and completion, so the requested security is maintained rather than merely announced.
State-transformation supplies the operative verb: the locality is to be brought into a condition of security.
A delimited terrestrial place supplies the civic container in which the requested condition must hold.
Calm trust opposed to fear gives security both a public and an inward register.
Active distancing supplies the boundary-maintenance operation that protects the family.
Submissive obedience identifies the danger as allegiance and practice, not mere proximity to an object.
The embodied object made into a recipient of worship fixes the concrete endpoint from which separation is sought.

changed_reading.before: A prayer that a city be safe and a family avoid idols.
changed_reading.after: A request to construct and maintain a bounded civic condition of trust by keeping an intergenerational household outside the allegiance-field of embodied cult objects.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ب ن ي term is joined to the speaker under first-person plural ع ب د, and the whole group is the object of the distancing imperative from ج ن ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The descendants are a lineage being assembled over time, while one ع ب د branch supplies the image of a road made passable through repeated treading. The prayer therefore resists not only a single cultic act but the wearing-in of idol service as the family's inherited route.

activation_trace.role: Descent from an originating line extends the requested protection through time.
Assembly by joining parts supplies a construction image for forming an enduring family practice.
A surface made tractable by repeated passage models how recurring practice can become an easy inherited route.
Reduction to servile labor exposes the loss of agency latent in habitual devotional submission.
Deliberate removal interrupts the route before it becomes normal for the next generation.

changed_reading.before: The father asks that his sons share his rejection of idols.
changed_reading.after: The father asks that repeated service never be worn into an inherited family road, protecting the construction of the lineage as well as each individual act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speakers defend the worship received from their fathers; later, the focus prayer is followed by a mirrored request that the speaker and his descendants be made maintainers of prayer. The context converts lineage from passive repetition into deliberate transmission: inherited idol service is interrupted and replaced by an actively sustained practice.

activation_trace.role: Lineal descent is the focus element whose mode of inheritance is being tested.
Removal from a harmful relation supplies the interruption between generations.
Submissive cultic practice is presented as the content inherited from the preceding generation.
Fatherhood joined with formative care makes ancestry a channel that can reproduce worship.
A second request for effected disposition supplies the positive counterpart to being kept away.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking turns prayer into maintained intergenerational work.
The specified devotional practice supplies the positive habit that replaces inherited idol service.

structural_cues: 14:10 places worship and fathers in one justification, while 14:35 places sons and worship in one prevention.
14:40 repeats the Lord-address plus making request and explicitly extends maintained prayer into the descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two generational constructions and the later positive prayer; I infer a designed reversal from mimetic ancestry to intentional transmission. A live alternative is that the passages merely contrast two families without defining a general mechanism of inheritance.

changed_reading.before: The sons are added as further persons who should not worship idols.
changed_reading.after: The sons make the prayer an intervention in inheritance: it prevents ancestral cult from reproducing itself and installs a consciously maintained devotional practice in its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The expulsion-or-return ultimatum and the answering promise of settlement make spatial security a condition of religious freedom. A secure locality is one from which a household cannot be expelled for refusing the dominant creed and therefore cannot be forced back into its allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The bounded land is the political space whose tenure can be protected or violated.
Freedom from anticipated harm supplies the condition required for uncoerced allegiance.
Religious separation becomes sustainable only when forced spatial removal is defeated.
Passage to the outside supplies dispossession as the threat opposed to a secure locality.
Return after departure supplies coerced re-entry into the former communal order.
An established creed supplies the affiliation to which the threatened return is directed.
Durable habitation answers expulsion with protected residence.
Expectation of harm keeps security tied to accountable fear rather than unrestricted autonomy.

structural_cues: 14:13 offers exactly two outcomes: removal from land or return to the coercer's creed.
14:14 answers that ultimatum with settlement in land after the oppressors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, coerced return, creed, and answering settlement; I infer that civic safety includes secure tenure for nonconformity. A live alternative is that the settlement promise is victory imagery adjacent to, but not constitutive of, the focus request.

changed_reading.before: Safety means general freedom from violence in the city.
changed_reading.after: Safety includes protected habitation that blocks the political mechanism by which expulsion can force a family back into an imposed cult.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stable tree sequence contrasts fixed origin and recurring yield with total uprooting and lack of resting ground. The later valley prayer then places descendants in an uncultivated site, gives them protected habitation and maintained prayer, and asks for fruit. Together these cues recast the secure city as rooting medium for a generative devotional lineage.

activation_trace.role: Attachment and residence in a locality make the city a medium of durable settlement.
Assembly into a built whole lets the descendants function as a social structure formed over time.
Settled confidence supplies the human analogue of a plant holding firmly in its medium.
A sustaining base supplies the lower anchor of the generative model.
Persistence supplies the condition under which upward branching can continue.
Removal as an entire rooted mass supplies the failure mode of a habitat without stability.
Stable resting gives the explicit spatial condition denied to the uprooted counter-model.
Placing descendants into habitation converts the tree's abstract stability into a settlement operation.
A protected spatial precinct supplies the boundary within which the settlement can organize itself.
Resolute rising to an undertaking makes prayer the settlement's maintained activity.
Ripened yield closes the movement from rooting and residence to generative provision.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 forms a fixed-origin, yield, uprooting, and no-resting-place contrast.
14:37 orders descendant settlement in an uncultivated valley, protected precinct, maintained prayer, and fruit provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the arboreal stability contrast and the later settlement sequence; I infer that the city functions as social rooting medium for the descendants. A live alternative is that the tree parable concerns speech and the valley prayer concerns habitation without a deliberate cross-domain transfer.

changed_reading.before: The city is a safe container for an already formed family.
changed_reading.after: The secure city is the rooting environment in which a vulnerable lineage can become stable, maintain worship, and yield across generations rather than be uprooted without a place of rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence before the focus traces a destructive civic production: blessing is exchanged for denial, a people are installed in an abode of ruin, and rivals are made so as to divert from a path. The focus reuses the making verb but gives it the opposite object and agent: the Lord is asked to make secure habitation and to prevent worship of manufactured rivals.

activation_trace.role: Effecting a state supplies the constructive making that answers the earlier destructive making.
The bounded locality is the social product whose condition is contested.
Trustful safety names the counter-state to ruin and diversion.
Replacement by a substitute starts the causal chain that corrupts a received good.
Installing a people in a place turns doctrinal substitution into civic placement.
Ruin and corruption identify the terminal habitat produced by the earlier substitution.
The same state-making operation is used to assign rival status, creating the formal reversal with the focus.
A counterpart set up in opposition supplies the manufactured equivalence that corrupts allegiance.
Loss of the intended direction supplies the social effect of making rivals.
A traversable route gives diversion a concrete directional target.

structural_cues: 14:28-30 runs from substitution of blessing to settlement in ruin to making rivals and diverting a path.
14:30 and 14:35 repeat the same making root with opposite products: rivals versus a secure locality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated making verb and the ordered social consequences; I infer that the focus is a counter-founding act. A live alternative is that the repetition marks only a lexical echo and that safety and rival-making remain separate petitions.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains one request for safety and another for protection from idols.
changed_reading.after: The two requests form an alternative civic founding: instead of manufacturing rival equivalences that settle a people in ruin, the Lord is asked to produce secure habitation by excluding that rival-making practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus catalog presents created systems as directed to human use and provision, then names blessing as uncountable and the human response as covering it. The post-focus valley prayer asks for provision that may issue in gratitude. Idol worship can therefore be read as a terminal attribution error: benefit is received through the Lord's ordering but devotional return is assigned to an embodied substitute.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and governing lordship identify the party to whom received goods properly refer back.
Devotional submission is the response whose recipient can be correctly or incorrectly assigned.
The embodied substitute supplies the false endpoint of devotional return.
Allocated giving identifies material benefit as a directed grant rather than ownerless supply.
Directed service toward a purpose presents created infrastructure as ordered for recipients.
Beneficial condition gathers the preceding provisions under the category of gift.
Covering a benefit supplies the failed response immediately before the focus prayer.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supplies the intended response after provision.

structural_cues: 14:32-34 moves from creation and directed service to provision, uncountable blessing, and human covering of blessing.
14:35-37 moves from idol avoidance to requested provision and the hoped-for response of gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grant-covering-gratitude sequence; I infer that worship is the culminating attribution of benefit and that idols intercept that return. A live alternative is that material gratitude and cultic allegiance are coordinated themes without a single accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Idol worship is a prohibited ritual attachment.
changed_reading.after: Idol worship is also the misdirection of gratitude: a made body receives the submission owed to the giver and governor of the city's sustaining goods.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier judgment scene denies coercive authority and reduces deceptive control to a call that people answer. Immediately after the focus, the idols are grammatically credited with leading many astray, followed by a contrast between following and disobeying. This turns worship from static contact with objects into a directional allegiance process of solicitation, response, and continued following.

activation_trace.role: Active separation blocks entry into the relational sequence before it becomes allegiance.
Submissive obedience names the settled relation produced when the sequence succeeds.
The worshiped body remains the concrete focus anchor even when agency is modeled relationally.
Capacity and governing force, explicitly denied in the verse, remove compulsion from the mechanism.
A vocal summons supplies the initiating movement toward a respondent.
Answering speech supplies the voluntary uptake that turns solicitation into a bond.
Loss of right direction describes the idols' stated effect on many people.
Following behind supplies the positive directional relation contrasted with idol-caused deviation.
Departure from obedience supplies the opposed allegiance outcome.

structural_cues: 14:22 explicitly juxtaposes absence of coercive authority with calling and answering.
14:36 gives the idols a plural agentive role in misguidance and then divides people by following or disobeying the speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call-response mechanics and the immediate mislead-follow-disobey grammar; I infer a shared model of mediated allegiance rather than autonomous object-power. A live alternative is that the Satan scene and the personified idols describe distinct agencies that should not be fully assimilated.

changed_reading.before: Keeping away from idols means avoiding physical cult objects and their rites.
changed_reading.after: Keeping away means preventing a call-response-following channel from taking hold, while the objects remain the visible nodes around which that allegiance is organized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending denies absolute stability to physical substrate: even mountains can be displaced, and the earth itself can be exchanged for another earth. This weakens any baseline that treats the requested city's security as inherent permanence and shifts weight toward security as a granted condition of relation and allegiance.

activation_trace.role: A condition effected upon a place already implies that its security is conferred rather than native.
The terrestrial locality is the apparently stable substrate that the ending relativizes.
Trust can remain meaningful even when permanence cannot be assigned to the ground itself.
Departure from place or condition supplies the possibility of displacement at maximal scale.
A massive elevated solid supplies the strongest terrestrial emblem of apparent fixity.
One thing taking another's place makes terrestrial replacement explicit.
The lower world opposed to the sky is itself the repeated object of replacement.

structural_cues: 14:48 repeats earth on both sides of a replacement construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement of the most solid terrain and replacement of earth; I infer that the focus seeks contingent earthly security rather than immutable ground. A live alternative is that eschatological replacement does not qualify the ordinary temporal scope of the city prayer.

changed_reading.before: A secure city is imagined as a permanently stable place.
changed_reading.after: The city's safety is a conferred and morally ordered condition within history; the ground itself is not the ultimate guarantor and can finally be displaced or replaced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant ب ن ي branch in which kin terms extend to small derivative things, including figurines, beside the explicit idol noun. It remains anchored by the focus's immediate descendants-to-idols construction, but downstream prose should present it only as an imagistic contrast, never as the lexical meaning of the sons term here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ب ن ي descendant term immediately precedes the collective worship construction whose object is ص ن م.

activation_trace.role: Kin naming extended to small offshoots and figurines creates an image-level bridge between living descendants and manufactured likenesses.
Actual descent from a source holds the living genealogical side of the contrast.
A crafted body treated as worshiped supplies the nonliving derivative side.
Devotional submission makes the direction of dependence run from living lineage toward manufactured body.

changed_reading.before: Living sons must be protected from worshiping statues.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the prayer opposes generative lineage to mimetic manufacture: living offshoots must not reverse dependence by submitting to human-made, offspring-like miniatures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because several focus branches align as a body: locality as chest, security as calm heart, side as bodily flank, and descendants as ribs or supports. The later heart imagery keeps it packet-anchored, but downstream prose should label it a somatic civic analogy rather than claim that the focus nouns literally carry all these senses in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The contiguous ب ل د, ء م ن, ج ن ب, and ب ن ي constructions permit a coordinated place-heart-side-support mapping.

activation_trace.role: The breast and upper chest image lets the locality be viewed as a civic torso.
Calm of the heart supplies the interior state sought for that civic body.
The bodily side supplies the perimeter at which harmful attachment is kept out.
Ribs and structural props make descendants supporting members of the civic body.
The heart as an internally kindled center supplies the social attraction that animates the settlement.
A heart weakened toward virtual absence supplies the failed opposite of civic inward security.
Air and vacancy give the failed heart an ungrounded interior.

changed_reading.before: The city is an external place in which a family seeks safety.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the city behaves like a civic body whose heart must be calmed, whose sides must be guarded, and whose descendants become supports rather than channels of internal collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus's requested side-distance against the ending's material coupling and fetters. It remains anchored in the opposed spatial branch images and in ع ب د branches of servitude, but downstream prose should qualify the movement from chosen worship to final binding as a reader-supplied moral materialization, not an explicit causal gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The family is the object of active distancing from an act whose ع ب د inventory includes servile possession and imposed subjection.

activation_trace.role: Separation and removal supply the preventative spatial motion.
Owned servitude exposes worship's possible relation to loss of freedom.
The act of reducing another to servile condition supplies the coercive potential within the allegiance.
Culpable violation identifies the people who undergo the terminal spatial reversal.
Joining one thing tightly to another reverses the focus's requested distancing.
Binding under restraint materializes the loss of freedom latent in servile allegiance.

changed_reading.before: Avoiding idols is preventative religious separation.
changed_reading.after: The requested separation also preempts a reversal in which chosen subjection hardens into compulsory coupling: those not kept apart from false allegiance end bound together under it.

strongest_changes: The father-and-sons wording became an intervention in inherited worship when set between the fathers' cult of 14:10 and the descendant prayer of 14:40.
The secure city became protected tenure against the expulsion-or-return coercion of 14:13-14.
The repeated making verb turned the focus into a counter-founding to the rival-making and civic ruin of 14:28-30.
The immediate sequel recast idol influence as a mediated call, response, misdirection, and following process.
The tree and valley sequences made security a rooting condition for a generative devotional settlement rather than static fortification.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly joined the focus's spatial, familial, devotional, and civic terms into mechanisms: secure tenure blocks coerced creed, intentional practice reverses passive inheritance, ordered provision demands correctly directed gratitude, and a protected settlement lets a lineage take root. The most distinctive packet-local outliers were the living-lineage versus figurine contrast, the civic-body mapping, and the reversal from side-distance to fettered coupling.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly coordinates civic safety, worship, provision, and gratitude, but it does not force every link to be one closed causal system.
The agentive idols of 14:36 may be personification rather than evidence that the call-response mechanics of 14:22 should be transferred wholesale.
The rooted-lineage and civic-body readings depend on explicit branch images but remain cross-domain activations rather than direct lexical renderings.
The final replacement of earth may relativize earthly security, or it may belong to a distinct eschatological horizon that leaves the local petition unqualified.
